selection_statements.text: The 80-fetus reference cohort was referred because of maternal alloimmunization or infection and was found unaffected; it is not an unselected population sample.
The abstract states that norms were constructed from 18 weeks until term and reports directions/significance, but not the numeric age-specific table or regression coefficients.
An additional 50 abnormal fetuses were used for paired maternal-fetal serum enzyme analyses; this separate group is excluded from the 80-fetus gas/pressure cohort.

limitations: The abstract gives no numeric age-specific pCO2, pO2 or pressure values, regression coefficients, confidence limits, age-bin counts or endpoint-specific denominators.
The 80-fetus cohort was referred for maternal alloimmunization or infection and found unaffected; selection limits generalization to unselected normal pregnancy.
An additional 50 abnormal fetuses formed a separate serum-enzyme analysis cohort and are not merged into this gas/pressure cohort.
The candidate contains qualitative trend statements only and does not define a biological support requirement, operating setpoint, safety envelope, or healthy-outcome prediction.
Publisher page marks the primary article PDF only; tables and reuse terms were not recovered. No author was contacted.
